what_happened.line: The School Committee voted unanimously, by roll call, to release the class of 2021's remaining funds to a new account set up by the class officers.
The committee voted unanimously, by roll call, to accept the class of 2021's Blue Knight statue as a gift, on the superintendent's advice.
The committee heard a presentation on the MYCAP college and career program, including a free state platform that may replace Naviance.
A partial superintendent evaluation summary rated proficient on all four standards and exemplary on fiscal systems; the full evaluation is to be posted on the district website.

The Finance Committee reported that the added primary school fire alarm cost can be covered within the current budget along with state money; the meeting ended in executive session on union negotiations.

why_it_matters: The MYCAP platform is free, so a switch from Naviance would touch the cost of the district's college and career planning software, though no decision was taken at this meeting.
The fire alarm work at the primary school was reported as fundable within the current budget plus state money, so it does not appear to need new local funds on the minutes' account.
watch_next: The full superintendent evaluation, which the minutes say is to be posted on the district website.
Any decision on replacing Naviance with the free state platform, which was presented but not voted on.
